summary: Helpful/not helpful rating with exclusive, clearable selection, controlled or uncontrolled.
whenToUse: Collecting an explicit rating of the response.
Connecting feedback to telemetry managed by the consumer.
whenNotToUse: Automatically measuring a model's correctness or safety.
Collecting personal data without an appropriate privacy notice.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Selection, changed answer, or null when clicking again.

inherits: HTML attributes of div, aria-label, className, style and an HTMLDivElement ref.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the two buttons.

accessibility: Localized visible text and aria-pressed state.
The selection also has a border, not just a color change.
customization: All labels can be overridden via LocaleProvider.
commonMistakes: Switching between controlled and uncontrolled during the component's lifetime.
Treating the callback as actual persistence.
